definition: A commitment that a facility or site this project finances will keep working when grid power fails: generators, batteries, uninterruptible power supply, solar with storage, dual grid feeds, fuel arrangements, or a specified number of hours of autonomy. Counts when the project finances it, requires it in tender documents or specifications, or makes the operator responsible for it. Does not count: a power or electrification project as such, a country's energy situation described as context, an existing arrangement described as background, or a general aim of reliable services.
